title: KASAN + lockdep AWS test build
description: Add CONFIG_KASAN=y, CONFIG_PROVE_LOCKING=y, CONFIG_DEBUG_ATOMIC_SLEEP=y to the kernel build in tests/ci/test-on-aws.sh and run the full test suite under it. This is the highest-leverage single action: catches use-after-free on session close, lock ordering violations (registry rwlock vs session mutex), and sleeping-in-atomic if any future path acquires a spinlock before calling a provider callback. Acceptance: test suite passes clean under the hardened kernel with zero KASAN splats, zero lockdep warnings, zero DEBUG_ATOMIC_SLEEP splats.
close_reason: Added KASAN_BUILD=1 support to test-on-aws.sh: Phase 1.5 builds custom kernel with CONFIG_KASAN=y+CONFIG_PROVE_LOCKING=y+CONFIG_DEBUG_ATOMIC_SLEEP=y from Ubuntu source, reboots, updates KVER/KGCC, continues testing under KASAN kernel. Phase 10 adds KASAN/lockdep splat check. Bash syntax verified.
